project.description: Official OpenAPI 3.1 specification for **BoxFleet** (`boxfleet` / `boxfleek` / `jackai-box`), generated and verified with **OmniWrap** for the `jackai-dev` ecosystem. BoxFleet unifies: - **Local Firecracker & WSL2 microVMs** with host-side model relay and zero guest credentials. - **25 Cloud & GPU Sandbox Providers** (`e2b`, `lambda`, `runpod`, `daytona`, `modal`, `beam`, `fly-machines`, `cloudflare-sandbox`, `koyeb`, `morph`, `blaxel`, `sprites`, `northflank`, `together`, `replicate`, `baseten`, `fal`, `fireworks`, `codesandbox`, `railway`, `render`, `hetzner`, `digitalocean`, `vultr`, `linode`, `instabox`, `molted`). - **BoxFleet Managed White-Label Cloud (`boxfleet-cloud`)**: Zero-idle-cost ($0/hr when suspended) instant microVMs, X11/noVNC `:1` GUI desktop streaming, serverless H100/A100/L4 GPUs, `tmpfs` `/run/boxfleet/vault` secret injection, and wake-on-HTTP preview URLs (`https://{port}-{boxId}.preview.boxfleet.io`). - **JackAISaaS Connect Multi-Tenant SaaS & Business/Enterprise Fleet Governance**: 5 tiers (`free`, `pro`, `team`, `business`, `enterprise`), RBAC seats, per-member box quotas, and live park control.
